Now I'm checking whether these vertices form cliques among themselves by verifying edges between pairs. I'm checking if {0,14,26} can be extended to a 4-clique by testing potential additions, but none of the candidates work out. After testing combinations, I found {0,14,40,56} forms a complete 4-clique, which means {0,8,9,14,26,40,56} is a 7-clique—I'm now verifying all 21 edges exist in the original graph to confirm this is valid.
